con:interface.name: Banking Management API
con:interface.con:description: Stateful banking contract for the v2 workflow example. All monetary values are integer minor units (12500 means EUR 125.00). Transfers are fee-free, same-currency, and between distinct active accounts owned by the authenticated customer. There is no overdraft facility. A pending transfer does not change posted balances. Completion atomically debits the source, credits the destination, and creates two ledger entries. Failed or rejected transfers have no balance or ledger effects. The authentication service and banking service share session revocation state. This file does not deploy a service. Supply an isolated implementation or stateful mock; static auto-mocking cannot verify these business semantics.

con:part.con:content: openapi: 3.0.3 info: title: Banking Management API version: 2.0.0 description: | Stateful banking contract for the v2 workflow example. All monetary values are integer minor units (12500 means EUR 125.00). Transfers are fee-free, same-currency, and between distinct active accounts owned by the authenticated customer. There is no overdraft facility. A pending transfer does not change posted balances. Completion atomically debits the source, credits the destination, and creates two ledger entries. Failed or rejected transfers have no balance or ledger effects. The authentication service and banking service share session revocation state. This file does not deploy a service. Supply an isolated implementation or stateful mock; static auto-mocking cannot verify these business semantics. servers: - description: SwaggerHub API Auto Mocking url: https://virtserver.swaggerhub.com/MConneely/banking-management-api/2.0.0 security: - bearerHttpAuthentication: [] paths: /accounts: get: operationId: listAccounts summary: List a customer's accounts using cursor pagination description: | Returns accounts sorted by ID in a stable snapshot. An omitted or empty cursor starts a new snapshot. Subsequent cursors preserve that snapshot and the original filters. nextCursor is null on the final page. An empty result returns items [] and nextCursor null, not 404. The authenticated customer must own customerId, otherwise return 403. parameters: - name: customerId in: query required: true schema: type: string minLength: 1 - name: status in: query schema: type: string enum: [active, closed] - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Cursor' - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Limit' responses: '200': description: One page of accounts content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/AccountPage' example: items: - id: acc-source customerId: customer-demo type: checking currency: EUR status: active balanceMinor: 50000 nextCursor: account-page-2 '400': $ref: '#/components/responses/InvalidRequest' '401': $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' '403': $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' /accounts/{accountId}: parameters: - $ref: '#/components/parameters/AccountId' get: operationId: getAccount summary: Retrieve a single owned account responses: '200': $ref: '#/components/responses/AccountResult' '401': $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' '403': $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' '404': $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' post: operationId: createAccount summary: Create an account with an initial posted balance description: | The ID must be new. The supplied customer must be the authenticated customer. New accounts are active and immediately readable. initialDepositMinor becomes balanceMinor. Creation is not idempotent; an existing ID returns 409 without modifying the account. requestBody: required: true content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateAccountRequest' example: customerId: customer-demo type: savings currency: EUR initialDepositMinor: 10000 responses: '201': $ref: '#/components/responses/AccountResult' '400': $ref: '#/components/responses/InvalidRequest' '401': $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' '403': $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' '409': description: Account ID already exists content: application/problem+json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' example: type: urn:banking:error:account-exists title: Account already exists status: 409 code: ACCOUNT_EXISTS detail: Choose a new account ID. put: operationId: updateAccount summary: Update an account's status description: | Supports active and closed. Closing is permitted only for a zero-balance account with no pending transfers. Reopening is permitted in this demo. The returned status is immediately visible to getAccount. requestBody: required: true content: application/json: schema: type: object additionalProperties: false required: [status] properties: status: type: string enum: [active, closed] responses: '200': $ref: '#/components/responses/AccountResult' '400': $ref: '#/components/responses/InvalidRequest' '401': $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' '403': $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' '404': $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' '409': description: Account has a nonzero balance or pending transfers content: application/problem+json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' example: type: urn:banking:error:account-not-closable title: Account cannot be closed status: 409 code: ACCOUNT_NOT_CLOSABLE detail: The account must have a zero balance and no pending transfers. /balance: get: operationId: getBalance summary: Retrieve an owned account's posted balance parameters: - $ref: '#/components/parameters/AccountQuery' responses: '200': description: Current posted balance content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/Balance' example: accountId: acc-source currency: EUR balanceMinor: 50000 '401': $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' '403': $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' '404': $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' /transactions: get: operationId: listTransactions summary: List an owned account's transactions using a stable snapshot description: | Inclusive UTC calendar-date boundaries. fromDate must be <= toDate when both are supplied. Results are sorted by date then ID. The cursor freezes the snapshot and filters; nextCursor null marks the final page. Omit unset dates; do not send literal null or empty date strings. An account without matching transactions returns an empty final page. parameters: - $ref: '#/components/parameters/AccountQuery' - name: fromDate in: query schema: type: string format: date - name: toDate in: query schema: type: string format: date - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Cursor' - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Limit' responses: '200': description: One page of transactions content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/TransactionPage' example: items: - id: txn-demo-1 accountId: acc-source transferId: transfer-demo-1 date: '2026-10-01' amountMinor: -12500 currency: EUR description: Transfer debit nextCursor: null '400': $ref: '#/components/responses/InvalidRequest' '401': $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' '403': $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' '404': $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' /transfers: post: operationId: submitTransfer summary: Accept a fee-free asynchronous transfer description: | Validate authentication before any side effect. A 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED guarantees no transfer was accepted, so recovery may safely replay. Source and destination must be distinct, active, same-currency accounts owned by the authenticated customer. Validate available funds, including pending reservations, before accepting. An accepted transfer starts pending and reserves funds without changing posted balances. Poll getTransfer to observe its terminal state. Idempotency keys are scoped to the customer and retained for at least 24 hours. The same key and body returns 200 with the same transfer ID and its current state, without another reservation or movement of funds. The same key with a different body returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Rejected requests do not reserve funds or create transfers. parameters: - name: Idempotency-Key in: header required: true schema: type: string minLength: 1 maxLength: 128 requestBody: required: true content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/TransferRequest' example: sourceAccountId: acc-source destinationAccountId: acc-destination amountMinor: 12500 currency: EUR responses: '202': description: New transfer accepted in pending state headers: Retry-After: description: Suggested delay before polling, in seconds schema: type: integer minimum: 0 content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/Transfer' example: transferId: transfer-demo-1 sourceAccountId: acc-source destinationAccountId: acc-destination amountMinor: 12500 currency: EUR status: pending '200': description: Existing transfer for the same idempotency key and body content: application/json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/Transfer' '400': $ref: '#/components/responses/InvalidRequest' '401': $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized' '403': $ref: '#/components/responses/Forbidden' '404': $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound' '409': description: Idempotency key reused with a different request content: application/problem+json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' example: type: urn:banking:error:idempotency-conflict title: Idempotency conflict status: 409 code: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT detail: This key was already used with a different payload. '422': description: Business rejection; no balance or ledger effects content: application/problem+json: schema: $ref: '#/components/schemas/Problem' examples: insufficientFunds: value: type: urn:banking:error:insufficient-funds title: Insufficient funds status: 422 code: INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS detail: Available funds are less than amountMinor. closedAccount: value: type: urn:banking:error:account-closed title: Account closed status: 422 code: ACCOUNT_CLOSED detail: Both accounts must be active. currencyMismatch: value: type: urn:banking:error:currency-mismatch title: Currency mismatch status: 422 code: CURRENCY_MISMATCH detail: Both accounts and the request must use the same currency. /transfers/{transferId}: get: operationId: getTransfer summary: Read a transfer's current state description: | State transitions are pending -> completed or pending -> failed. Terminal states never change. A failed transfer has a failureCode and releases its reservation without changing balances or creating entries. completed is visible only after both balances and ledger entries commit. Only the owning customer may retrieve the transfer. parameters: - name: transferId in: path required: true schema: type: string minLength: 1 responses: '200': description: Current transfer state; a failed state includes failureCode headers: Retry-After: description: Suggested polling delay in seconds when pending schema: type: integer minimum: 0 content: application/json: schema: $ref:
